name: 12061 · E Greenbush, NY
findings: ZIP 12061 (E Greenbush) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12061 (E Greenbush) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12061 (E Greenbush) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
